## &#127912; The official colour of this homepage

::: gc-center
<span class="gc-swatch"><i></i><b>Lettuce Green</b><span>PANTONE 13-0324 TCX</span><span>#BED38E</span><span>rgb(190, 211, 142)</span></span>
:::

Every green on this site is that one Pantone chip, tinted for the panels and
shaded for the sidebar, with radish red <code>#C8395B</code>, butter yellow
<code>#F0C040</code> and ink blue <code>#1C4F7C</code> as the accents. If you
want the whole set, they are the custom properties at the top of
[`assets/geocities.css`](assets/geocities.css).
